threat_event: Staff accounts on the student information and financial aid system are taken over without MFA, leading to theft of student financial data or aid fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA not enforced on the SIS; 2025 mailbox compromise shows phishing exposure (group gap 5)
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (MFA not enforced on the SIS); EV-082 (2025 mailbox compromise)
existing_controls: Email MFA; EDR on College servers
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for all SIS users by 2026-11-30 (POAM-020); move to SYS-G1 by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Safeguards do not match current risks because the written risk assessment is outdated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Written risk assessment from 2022, before the acquisition and the file share move
likelihood_basis: EV-078 (2022 assessment); EV-076 (2025 compliance audit finding)
treatment_plan: New written risk assessment using the group method (POAM-019)

threat_event: Student rosters emailed to hospitals go to the wrong recipient or are intercepted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rosters exported to spreadsheets and emailed without encryption
existing_controls: Student FERPA consent for placement disclosures
treatment_plan: Secure roster feed into hospital identity governance (POAM-001)

threat_event: College financial aid and registrar files on the group file service are stolen in a data center incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files moved to DC1 in 2025 with old permission groups
treatment_plan: Re-permission shares; move documents into the SIS (GR-11 plan)

threat_event: The College directory is compromised and used to reach College systems and shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate directory without group monitoring of identity events
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (separate directory); EV-010 (College identity events not in the SIEM)
treatment_plan: Migrate to SYS-G1; interim identity event forwarding to the SIEM

threat_event: The FSA breach report or the FTC Safeguards Rule notice is missed after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: College IR plan (2022) not part of the group plan; FSA and FTC contacts missing from the group matrix
likelihood_basis: EV-082 (2022 plan outside the group plan); EV-012 (FSA and FTC contacts missing); EV-076 (SAIG agreement)
regulatory_driver: N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(h), (j)); FSA breach reporting (SAIG agreement)
treatment_plan: Fold the College into the group plan and matrix (POAM-021)

threat_event: College leadership and the board lack a view of program status because no annual Qualified Individual report was made
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written report to the board since 2023
existing_controls: Informal updates to the College president
treatment_plan: Written annual report to the board risk committee (POAM-025)

threat_event: Attackers operate unseen on campus networks and College SaaS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Campus network and SaaS logs not in the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (campus and SaaS logs not onboarded); EV-081 (last penetration test 2023)
existing_controls: EDR alerts reach the group SOC
treatment_plan: Forward SIS and campus firewall logs to the SIEM (POAM-004)

threat_event: The SIS vendor has a breach of student records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor SOC 2 report reviewed at contract only
treatment_plan: Annual vendor review under group third-party risk

threat_event: AI proctoring flags students unfairly or keeps face data longer than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Webcam video and face detection; flags reviewed by faculty; contract silent on face data retention
likelihood_basis: EV-084 (contract silent on face data retention); EV-032 (proctoring in use); EV-095 (faculty review of flags)
regulatory_driver: N61-R01 (34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(i)(B)); Fla. Stat. 501.702 (biometric data definition, applicability unsettled)
existing_controls: Faculty review every flag; no automatic penalties
treatment_plan: Contract terms on retention and use; flag-rate review by student group (P10)

threat_event: A phishing email leads to payroll diversion or a College mailbox compromise
College staff follow pre-acquisition standards that conflict with group policy
Real patient information from rotations appears in teaching material in the LMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Students and faculty capture case details for assignments
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (Hospital System policy on trainees); Privacy Rule 164.514(b)
treatment_plan: Assignment rules and LMS keyword checks; joint hospital and College guidance

threat_event: Records of 31,000 former students are kept longer than needed, widening any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disposal schedule for former students' financial aid documents
existing_controls: Records kept per accreditor and Title IV record rules
treatment_plan: Disposal schedule reviewed against record-keeping duties

threat_event: College staff are not trained on current threats
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: College training separate from the group program; no phishing exercises
treatment_plan: Move College staff to the group training and phishing program (POAM-022)

threat_event: Simulation lab equipment or the academic EHR is misused
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the College IT director
